words.ex: I didn't expect to see you here!
use: We expect the package to arrive tomorrow.
Don't expect too much from the movie.
mcq: I expect that he will come.
He expects me that I go.
words.note: expect + that절 / expect + to부정사. 'expect him coming'은 어색해요.

words.ex: Can I suggest a different plan?
use: I suggest that we take a break.
mcq: I suggest you to go home early.
I suggest to go home early.
words.note: suggest + -ing! 'suggest to go'는 한국인이 가장 많이 틀리는 형태예요.

words.ex: I totally agree with you.
use: We agreed to meet next week.
I don't agree with that idea.
words.note: agree with + 사람/의견. 'I am agree'는 be동사 없이 I agree!

words.ex: What time does the train arrive?
use: We arrived at the hotel around noon.
She arrived in Seoul last night.
words.note: arrive at + 장소(건물), arrive in + 도시/나라. arrive to는 없어요!

words.ex: Will you attend the meeting tomorrow?
use: About fifty people attended the seminar.
I can't attend the wedding this Saturday.
mcq: I will attend to the meeting.
I will attend at the meeting.
I will attend in the meeting.
words.note: attend + 행사 바로 연결! 전치사를 넣는 게 대표적인 실수예요.

words.ex: You can achieve anything if you try.
use: We achieved our sales goal this month.
She achieved great success in her career.
mcq: He achieved to pass the exam.
He achieved his goal at last.
words.note: achieve + 명사(목표·성공). achieve to는 쓰지 않아요.

words.ex: Please raise your hand if you have a question.
use: Can I raise one more question?
mcq: They raised the price last month.
The price was raise by them.
They rose the price last month.
words.note: raise는 목적어가 필요(올리다). 스스로 오르는 건 rise! rise-rose-risen과 혼동 주의.

words.ex: We finally reached the top of the mountain.
use: You can reach me by email anytime.
mcq: We reached to the station at 9.
We reached at the station at 9.
We reached in the station at 9.
words.note: reach + 장소 바로 연결! arrive at과 헷갈려서 reach to로 쓰기 쉬워요.

words.ex: She has a successful career in marketing.
words.exko: 그녀는 마케팅 분야에서 성공적인 커리어를 쌓았어요.
use: I want to change my career path.
He spent his whole career at one company.
mcq: I built my career in education.
words.note: career는 '직업명'이 아니라 '경력의 흐름'이에요. My job is~ 와 구분!

words.ex: My goal is to speak English fluently.
words.exko: 제 목표는 영어를 유창하게 하는 거예요.
use: We set a goal for this year.
mcq: I made a goal to exercise daily.
I set a goal to exercise daily.
I built a goal to exercise.
I put a goal to exercise.
words.note: 목표를 '세우다'는 set a goal! make보다 set이 자연스러워요.

words.ex: I'm having trouble with my computer.
use: He got into trouble at school.
mcq: I have trouble to sleep at night.
I have trouble sleeping at night.
I have a trouble for sleeping.
words.note: have trouble + -ing! 'trouble to sleep'이 아니에요.

words.ex: Please contact me if you have questions.
use: I'll contact you as soon as possible.
words.note: contact + 사람 바로 연결! contact to/with는 대표적인 한국식 오류예요.

words.ex: This watch has great sentimental value.
use: The value of the house went up.
mcq: This experience is value to me.
This experience has value to me.
words.note: have value = 가치가 있다. valuable(형용사)과 구분하세요.

words.ex: This is my second attempt at the test.
use: He attempted to fix it himself.
mcq: I attempted that I solve it.
words.note: attempt + to부정사. try보다 격식 있는 말이에요.

words.ex: Please let me know in advance.
use: Technology advances so fast these days.
Thank you in advance for your help.
words.note: in advance = 미리. 전치사 in이 고정이에요.

words.ex: The company has about 200 employees.
mcq: I am an employee at a bank.
I am an employer at a bank as staff.
I work as an employer for my boss.
words.note: employee = 고용된 직원, employer = 고용주(회사). -ee가 '받는 쪽'!

words.ex: I try to exercise three times a week.
words.note: do exercise 또는 그냥 exercise(동사). play는 구기 종목에만!

words.ex: Push the door, don't pull it.
use: Don't push me, I need time.
She pushed herself to finish the race.
mcq: He pushed me to try again.
He pushed that I try again.
He pushed to me for trying.
words.note: push + 사람 + to부정사 = ~하도록 밀어붙이다.

words.ex: Your English is improving fast!
use: I want to improve my speaking skills.
The weather improved in the afternoon.
words.note: improve 하나로 충분해요. improve up 같은 군더더기 불필요!

words.ex: The hotel provides free breakfast.
use: We provide customers with fast service.
The company provided lunch for everyone.
mcq: They provide us with good service.
They provide to us good service.
They provide good service for we.
words.note: provide A with B = A에게 B를 제공하다. with를 빼먹기 쉬워요!
